## Summary

Describe the behavior changed and why it belongs in ContextSift.

## Validation

- [ ] Offline tests pass.
- [ ] New behavior has tests or a documented reason why it cannot be tested offline.
- [ ] Documentation matches the implemented behavior.
- [ ] Generated runtime data and machine-specific paths are excluded.
- [ ] No credentials, private prompts, or proprietary artifacts are included.
- [ ] Benchmark claims include model, workload, task quality, and limitations.

## Security and context impact

Describe new permissions, external calls, execution behavior, context sources, and expected token impact.
